dict.string: FumetoReaderPlus connects to the comic servers (Komga, Kavita, YACReader) and translation servers (LM Studio) you add on your network.
FumetoReaderPlus reads the comic libraries you add from your Documents folder.
FumetoReaderPlus reads the comic libraries and files you add from your Downloads folder.
FumetoReaderPlus reads the comic libraries and files you add from your Desktop.
FumetoReaderPlus reads the comic libraries you add from external drives.
FumetoReaderPlus reads the comic libraries you add from network shares.
